parameters.name: L2Preload
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to directly prefetch content to L2 nodes. Valid values:

- **true**: The prefetch node level must include L2 nodes.

- **false**: Only back-to-origin layer nodes are prefetched. This is the **default value**. The back-to-origin layer node may be an L2 node or an L3 node.

parameters.name: ObjectPath
WithHeader
parameters.description: The default header carried in a prefetch request is Accept-Encoding:gzip. If you want the prefetch request to carry other headers or implement multi-copy prefetch, use this parameter to customize prefetch headers. Submit the value in JSON format.
